summary: Implemented centralized error envelope, structured JSON logging with secret redaction, and request tracing middleware, verified across live API endpoints and 41 automated test cases.
evidence: Added apps/api/app/core/logging.py with StructuredJsonFormatter logging request_id, route, method, status_code, and latency_ms while strictly redacting sensitive headers (Authorization, X-API-Key) and sentinel secrets (DO_NOT_LOG_ME_123).

Implemented pure ASGI RequestTracingMiddleware and FastAPI exception handlers in apps/api/app/main.py returning standardized error envelopes (error.code, error.message, error.request_id) with zero stack trace leakage on 4xx and 5xx responses.

Executed verify_module05_build.py capturing live evidence in progress/evidence/module-05/build-evidence.txt: validated HTTP 400 error envelope, proved DO_NOT_LOG_ME_123 never appears in server logs, and verified 41/41 unit and security tests passed in pytest.
